# ID Craft India

> ID Craft India is a premier manufacturer and supplier of premium PVC ID cards in India, specializing in high-definition, waterproof, and bulk ID card printing for educational institutions, corporate enterprises, hospitals, and government offices.

## Overview
We provide end-to-end bulk identity card printing services with PAN India delivery. Our manufacturing facility uses advanced thermal retransfer printing technology on durable 0.76mm PVC to ensure scratch-resistant, long-lasting smart cards.

## Core Products
- **Educational IDs:** Student, Teacher, and University Faculty ID Cards.
- **Corporate & Business IDs:** Employee Badges, IT Company ID Cards.
- **Healthcare IDs:** Hospital Staff, Doctor, and Nurse ID Cards.
- **Specialty Cards:** Visitor Passes, Gym Memberships, Loyalty Cards, Government IDs.

## Technical Specifications & Features
- **Material:** Premium Grade Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC) - 0.76mm thickness (Credit Card standard).
- **Durability:** 100% Waterproof, scratch-resistant, and bend-resistant.
- **Printing:** HD photo printing, edge-to-edge, dual-side capability.
- **Smart Features:** Scannable QR Codes and Barcodes (Code 39, Code 128) for automated attendance and access control.
- **Finishes:** Available in both Matte and Glossy finishes with optional lanyard slot punching.

## Target Audience & Service Areas
- **Industries:** Schools, Colleges, Coaching Institutes, Hospitals, Factories, Corporate Offices, Hotels, and Retail.
- **Locations Served:** PAN India delivery with expedited service in Delhi NCR, Noida, Gurgaon, Ghaziabad, Faridabad, Lucknow, Kanpur, Jaipur, and Chandigarh.

## Why Choose ID Craft India?
1. Fast bulk production scaling to thousands of cards.
2. Factory-direct affordable pricing with bulk discounts.
3. Guaranteed 100% scannability for QR and Barcode access systems.
4. Free physical sample kits provided to institutional buyers for quality assurance.
5. Dedicated design support and streamlined onboarding process.

## Contact Information
For bulk quotes, sample requests, and orders, customers can reach ID Craft India directly via our website's contact forms or our dedicated WhatsApp business channel.
